topics.title: Forum rules
topics.author: starbuck
topics.body:
Keep to the point and respect each other. Questions about the engine go to "Questions and answers", ideas to "Ideas and suggestions".

Search before asking: the answer may be there already.

topics.title: How do I change the site's logo?
topics.author: jim_hawkins
topics.body: I've installed a site and there's an orca in the header. Where do I put my own logo?

replies.author: starbuck
replies.body: Admin → Site information, the Logo field. The name and the slogan are there too.

topics.title: The dark scheme by default
topics.author: captain_nemo
topics.body: How about opening the site in the dark scheme when the visitor's system uses it?

replies.author: ishmael
replies.body: I like that it's light by default.

replies.author: queequeg
replies.body: Could be a theme setting - each site would choose.

topics.title: What to read about the sea?
topics.author: ishmael
topics.body: I'll start with Moby-Dick. Share your books about the sea and ships.

replies.author: captain_nemo
replies.body: Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Sea, of course.

replies.author: long_john_silver
replies.body: Treasure Island. There's a most charming cook in it.
